title: motion-anything: chat-native motion engine with 403 recipes and Lottie/MP4 export
summary: Open-source nexu-io motion-anything repo: describe motion in chat, edit on a live page via eight agent engines, export JSON/CSS/React/Lottie/MP4/GIF, and ship portable skills with 403 curated recipes and zero npm deps.
question_it_answers: How does motion-anything generate and export web motion from natural-language prompts?

claims.text: The repo ships 403 curated motion recipes spanning kinetic text, GPU shaders, and canvas effects.
claims.evidence: 403 curated motion recipes (kinetic text, GPU shaders, canvas effects)
claims.subject: code-motion-graphics

claims.text: Eight coding-agent engines plus BYOK are supported including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini.
claims.evidence: 8 coding-agent engines + BYOK (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok, Hermes, Gemini, Open Design Cloud)
claims.subject: code-motion-graphics

claims.text: Exports include JSON, CSS, React, Lottie, MP4, GIF, and portable skills from the workbench.
claims.evidence: Export: JSON, CSS, React, Lottie, MP4, GIF, portable skills
